verses.mystical_translation: I will love you, O the Living Presence, my strength.
The the Living Presence is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my the Divine, my strength, in whom I will trust; my shield, and the horn of my deliverance and wholeness, and my high tower.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of patterns rooted in harm men made me afraid.
The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the snares of death confronted me.
In my distress I called upon the the Living Presence, and cried to my the Divine: he heard my voice out of his sanctuary, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at your rebuke, O the Living Presence, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the the Living Presence was my stay.
He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
The the Living Presence rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.
For I have kept the ways of the the Living Presence, and have not wickedly departed from my the Divine.
For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
Therefore has the the Living Presence recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
With the merciful you will show thyself merciful; with an upright man you will show thyself upright;
With the pure you will show thyself pure; and with the froward you will show thyself froward.
For you will save the afflicted people; but will bring down high looks.
For you will light my candle: the the Living Presence my the Divine will enlighten my darkness.
For by you I have run through a troop; and by my the Divine have I leaped over a wall.
As for the Divine, his way is perfect: the word of the the Living Presence is tried: he is a shield to all those that trust in him.
For who is the Divine save the the Living Presence? or who is a rock save our the Divine?
It is the Divine that girdeth me with strength, and makes my way perfect.
He makes my feet like the feet of a deer and sets me securely on my heights.

You have also given me the shield of your deliverance and wholeness: and your right hand has holden me up, and your gentleness has made me great.
You have enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

They cried, but there was none to save them: even to the the Living Presence, but he answered them not.
Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
You have delivered me from the strivings of the people; and you have made me the head of the nations: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves to me.
The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
The the Living Presence liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the the Divine of my deliverance and wholeness be exalted.
It is the Divine that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

Therefore will I give thanks to you, O the Living Presence, among the nations, and sing praises to your name.
Great deliverance gives he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

contemplative_note: The poem magnifies rescue through storm and battle imagery while still locating strength beyond the warrior.
safety_note: This royal war song cannot authorize holy war, nationalism, torture, domination, or modern enemy-mapping. Preserve its violence without endorsing it.
